name: @joinearlybird/annokit
description: AnnoKit: a dev-only in-app annotation overlay for React Native and Expo. Tap an element, say what should change, and send it to your AI coding agent or your team.
author: Earlybird <founders@joinearlybird.com>

scripts.build: npm run build:stage && npm run build:types && npm run build:cjs && npm run build:esm && npm run build:swap
scripts.build:cjs: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --module node16 --moduleResolution node16 --outDir .lib-staging/commonjs --declaration false --declarationMap false && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('.lib-staging/commonjs/package.json','{\"type\":\"commonjs\"}\n')"
scripts.build:esm: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --module esnext --outDir .lib-staging/module --declaration false --declarationMap false && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('.lib-staging/module/package.json','{\"type\":\"module\"}\n')"
scripts.examples:reset: git checkout -- examples/expo examples/bare-react-native && git clean -fd examples/expo examples/bare-react-native
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run validate:package
scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true; [ -f lib/module/index.js ] || npm run build
